name: Variable ordering: the tight variables D and E come late
note: Order A, B, C, D, E. D < E with E in {1,2} forces D = 1, E = 2, but D and E are listed last. Backtracking in the given order tries 58 values (it keeps re-trying the irrelevant B and C); with 'most constraints first' (order D, E, A, B, C) only 7. Forward checking needs 27 values in the given order and 6 with 'smallest domain first' (MRV), which picks C, then E, and then D is forced. Arc consistency (run Arc consistency) also fixes D = 1 and E = 2 and shrinks A to {2,3} and B to {1,3}, but leaves A, B, C ambiguous: search is still needed.
